text.name: Tome of Twilight Magic
text.description:
{Tome of Twilight Magic}

This heavy book contains all spells in the schools of Light and Dark Magic. It must be equipped for the spells to be available.
text.event: You come across a conjurer who begs to accompany you and your army awhile for safety. You agree, and he offers as payment a copy of a book of the elements.
